taxonomy_fields.label: Are you applying as an individual or with family dependents?
What is your nationality?
Are you a citizen of an EU, EEA, or Swiss country?
Are you applying in Spain under EU family-member residence rules?
Do you plan to work or carry out any paid professional activity while living in Spain?
Are you currently living in Spain without valid legal status — for example, overstaying a visa or having entered without authorization?
What monthly amount in EUR can you support from passive income or available assets without working in Spain?
taxonomy_fields.description: Spain NLV screening requires monthly passive income or assets equal to at least 400% of Spain's IPREM (a public income reference index the government updates periodically) for the main applicant, plus 100% of IPREM for each dependent.

taxonomy_fields.label: Which documents can you provide as proof of passive income or available assets?
Do any of the funds supporting your Spain NLV case come from shares or ownership in a company based in Spain?
Do you perform any labor or professional work for that company?
How many dependents are included in your application?
What is each dependent's relationship to you?
What is the age of each dependent?
If any of your dependent children are of compulsory school age (typically 6–16), can they be enrolled in school during your stay in Spain?
How many months will your passport be valid from your intended Spain application or entry date?
Do you have qualifying health insurance with an insurer authorized to operate in Spain, or will you obtain it?
Can you obtain criminal record certificates for your country of origin and countries of residence during the previous 5 years?
Do you have any criminal convictions that may appear on those background checks?
Have you ever been refused entry to Spain or another Schengen country, been deported, or been flagged as a public-order or security risk?
Do you have any disease with serious public-health implications under the International Health Regulations?
taxonomy_fields.description: This is a rare requirement under international health rules and does not apply to common or manageable conditions.

taxonomy_fields.label: What else about your Spain Non-Lucrative Visa situation should QIQ consider?
